description: Drive a real iPhone or an iOS Simulator with an AI agent, through XCUIAutomation. Every action returns the screen it produced; anything that sends, pays or deletes asks first.

transport.note: Runs on the developer's own Mac, which must have Xcode and a simulator or an attached iPhone. Start it with `uvx ios-mcp serve --transport http`; it binds loopback only and has no authentication. Most clients launch it over stdio instead: `uvx ios-mcp`.
